CO-197.plain_language: The provider didn't get the required 'OK' from the plan before the service.
CO-197.script: I'm calling about claim [ID]. My plan denied this because a prior authorization was not filed. As an in-network provider, please submit a retroactive authorization to resolve this.

CO-16.plain_language: The insurance company needs more details from your doctor to see why this was necessary.
CO-16.script: My claim was denied for missing information. Please resubmit the claim with the clinical notes and office visit records for [Date].

CO-4.plain_language: The billing code used by the provider doesn't match the service that was performed.
CO-4.script: I'm calling about claim [ID]. The denial code indicates a modifier issue. Please review the procedure and modifier codes, correct any errors, and resubmit.

CO-29.plain_language: The claim was submitted too late. Providers must file within the plan's deadline.
CO-29.script: My claim was denied for late filing. Please check your records for the original submission date and file an appeal with proof of timely filing if applicable.

PR-1.plain_language: This amount is your responsibility because you haven't met your annual deductible yet.
PR-1.script: No provider action needed. This amount applies to your annual deductible. Check your plan's Explanation of Benefits for your remaining deductible balance.

PR-2.plain_language: After the plan paid its share, this is the percentage you owe based on your coinsurance rate.
PR-2.script: No provider action needed. This is your coinsurance portion. Refer to your SBC under Cost Sharing for your coinsurance percentage for this service category.
